question: Why are valid and erroneous measures unfitting in the sole abode of direct experience?
premises: This is the sole abode of experience.
Valid measure and erroneous measure are epistemic tools.
inference: Direct experience as the ultimate abode transcends the applicability of both valid and invalid measurement.
uncertainties: The scope of māna/vimāna may include specific pramāṇa categories.
plain_english: Here, in the sole abode of experience, neither valid measure nor erroneous measure is fitting.
